arts.ttl: Borussia Dortmund vs Villarreal predictions: Hosts can sink Yellow Submarine
arts.sum: Borussia Dortmund can add to Villarreal's woes in the Champions League this season when they meet at Signal Iduna Park on Tuesday night, according to Alex Jack.

Borussia Dortmund return to Signal Iduna Park with an opportunity to strengthen their position in the league phase, while Villarreal arrive at the foot of the standings and in urgent need of a revival...
